outputs.explanation: Scatter plot where each point is an individual sample (n=141); side histograms show distributions, not means requiring point overlay. Scatter plots are exempt from this check.
This is a scatter plot (each marker = one cell line/reporter) with error bars denoting replicate variability; scatter plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlay.
Density/distribution line plots showing fitted normal distributions across subtypes; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.
Box plots are exempt from requiring point overlay by default, and individual sample data points are additionally overlaid on the boxes.
Polar histograms display normalized probability distributions of phase differences (a form of histogram), not means requiring point overlay.
Polar histogram showing subtype-averaged probability distribution of phase differences; histograms are not bar charts of means requiring individual point overlay.
Illustrative example line plot of a fitted model on a single trace, not an averaged summary statistic requiring individual data points; line plots are exempt.
Scatter plot where each marker represents an individual sample (n=117) with error bars reflecting fit uncertainty; scatter plots are exempt from requiring point overlay.
